texto:
Charge: Assault causing bodily injury.
Elements the prosecution must prove beyond a reasonable doubt: (1) the defendant intentionally or knowingly caused bodily injury to another person; and (2) the defendant did not act in lawful self-defense.
ponto_disputado: Quem iniciou a agressão e se a reação foi legítima defesa, ou se o réu foi corretamente identificado como autor.

texto:
Charge: Retail theft (shoplifting) of merchandise valued over $500.
Elements the prosecution must prove beyond a reasonable doubt: (1) the defendant took merchandise from a store without paying; (2) the defendant intended to permanently deprive the store of the merchandise; and (3) the merchandise was worth more than $500.
ponto_disputado: Identidade do autor e intenção de subtrair (esquecimento, engano ou erro do caixa).

texto:
Charge: Residential burglary.
Elements the prosecution must prove beyond a reasonable doubt: (1) the defendant entered a dwelling without permission; and (2) at the time of entry, the defendant intended to commit a theft inside.
ponto_disputado: Identidade do autor a partir de provas circunstanciais (objetos encontrados, vestígios, horários).

texto:
Charge: Embezzlement by an employee.
Elements the prosecution must prove beyond a reasonable doubt: (1) the defendant was entrusted with the employer's money or property because of the job; and (2) the defendant knowingly took or converted that money or property for personal use.
ponto_disputado: Se o réu, e não outra pessoa com o mesmo acesso, fez as transações, e se agiu com dolo.

texto:
Charge: Leaving the scene of a collision that caused injury (hit-and-run).
Elements the prosecution must prove beyond a reasonable doubt: (1) the defendant was driving a vehicle involved in a collision that injured another person; (2) the defendant knew or reasonably should have known that the collision occurred; and (3) the defendant left the scene without stopping to give information or aid.
ponto_disputado: Quem dirigia o veículo e se o motorista percebeu a colisão.
